tasks_completed.description: M1+M2: Fix save.py _apply_select_mutation and _apply_skip_mutation slot write paths
tasks_completed.changes: Added _get_or_create_slot() helper that routes accommodation to day['accommodation'] (top-level) and all 6 named slots to day['slots'][slot_id] per schemas/v2/day.schema.json:53-70. Both _apply_select_mutation and _apply_skip_mutation now use this helper.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA confirmed save.py:55 and :63 wrote day.setdefault(slot_id, ...) to top-level, violating schema additionalProperties:false at root. Codex adversarial review caught that a naive slots-only fix would misroute accommodation mutations — _get_or_create_slot() handles the bifurcation.

tasks_completed.description: M3: Fix budget.py _sum_slots to read from day['slots']
tasks_completed.changes: Line 87: day.get(sid, {}) -> day.get('slots', {}).get(sid, {}). accommodation at budget.py:128 unchanged (correct top-level path per schema lines 67-70).
tasks_completed.rationale: BA confirmed budget.py:87 read slots from top-level, returning {} for every named slot and thus zero cost for all meals/activities.

tasks_completed.description: M4: Remove state.js lines 484-492 client-side top-level mirror workaround
tasks_completed.changes: Deleted 9 lines: comment + if block that mirrored day[slotId] at top level as a workaround for the Bug 1 save.py pattern. commit() call preserved.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA confirmed the workaround was explicitly named as compensating for Bug 1; with Bug 1 fixed, it would actively re-corrupt day files.

tasks_completed.description: M5: Add StateMachineError to errors.py, wire validate_state_transition in save.py
tasks_completed.changes: errors.py: StateMachineError(TripContractError) class added. save.py: imported validate_state_transition, StateMachineError, STAGES; _apply_stage_mutation now calls validate_state_transition and raises StateMachineError on illegal backward transition; old_stage defaults to STAGES[0] only when 'stage' key is absent (not when it's None or empty string, per codex feedback).
tasks_completed.rationale: State machine module existed but was never called from the save handler. save.py:69-72 set day['stage'] unconditionally.

tasks_completed.description: M6: Add StateMachineError catch to serve-trip.py _handle_post_save
tasks_completed.changes: Added StateMachineError import. Wrapped handle_save() in try/except StateMachineError; returns HTTPStatus.CONFLICT (409) with {error: state_machine, detail: str(e)}. Existing 409-soft advisory path (HTTP 200) unchanged.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA spec AC4 requires HTTP 409 on backward stage transition at HTTP dispatch layer.

tasks_completed.description: M7: Add reportlab==4.5.1 and icalendar==7.1.0 to requirements.txt; install packages
tasks_completed.changes: Added two pinned entries in alphabetically ordered position. Both packages installed with pip install --break-system-packages. pip show confirms reportlab 4.5.1 and icalendar 7.1.0 are now present.
tasks_completed.rationale: Exporters import both at module level; neither was in requirements.txt, causing ImportError on /api/export endpoints.

tasks_completed.changes: Moved 6 named slots under 'slots': {...} dict. Removed misleading 'Slots sit at top-level day keys (save.py shape)' comment. Changed intra_city_routes: [] to intra_city_routes: {} (matching schema type:object).
tasks_completed.rationale: Fixture was building day dicts with wrong v1 shape; all tests exercising the fixed code paths would have read correct (but mis-located) slot data. intra_city_routes[] was also wrong type.

tasks_completed.description: M9/AC8: Fix test_save_endpoint.py line 51 slot assertion
tasks_completed.changes: Line 51: day.get('breakfast', {}) -> day['slots']['breakfast']. Added test_backward_stage_mutation_raises_state_machine_error() (C1/AC4 unit test).
tasks_completed.rationale: With M8 fix, the slot lives under day['slots']['breakfast']; the old path would return {} and assertion would fail. AC4 required at minimum a unit test for backward transition.

tasks_completed.description: S1: Fix test_budget_endpoint.py test_null_cost_counts_as_unknown inline day dict
tasks_completed.changes: Moved inline day dict's 6 named slots under 'slots': {...} key; changed intra_city_routes: [] to {}. test now exercises budget.py's fixed _sum_slots path.
tasks_completed.rationale: BA spec S1: fix any remaining test_budget_endpoint.py slot-path mismatches after conftest fix. This test builds its own day dict inline and would have read 0 from slots.

git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A - fresh v2 server implementation, not a regression
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: v2 schema placed slots under day['slots']; server handlers were written or copied from pre-v2 (flat) shape without updating slot access patterns. State machine module was never wired into save handler. Exporter packages were not added to requirements.txt.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: All 4 slot path sites corrected to use v2 schema paths. validate_state_transition wired into save handler. Both pip packages added to requirements.txt and installed.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: 8 distinct bugs across 9 files; _get_or_create_slot helper added to prevent accommodation misrouting (caught by codex adversarial review as blocker); AC4 backward-transition test added (C1/required by spec AC4). All additions are directly mandated by BA spec or codex blocker fix.

dev.qa_notes: Run pytest tests/server/ (24 tests, all pass). Key checks: (1) AC1: day file written after select/skip mutation has slot under day['slots'][slot_id], not top-level; accommodation mutations go to top-level day['accommodation']. (2) AC2: budget recompute returns non-zero meals/activities from day['slots']. (3) AC3: state.js requestSelectMutation no longer writes to day[slotId] top-level. (4) AC4: test_backward_stage_mutation_raises_state_machine_error confirms StateMachineError on backward transition; serve-trip.py _handle_post_save returns HTTP 409. (5) AC5: forward transitions still succeed (test_valid_save_writes_stage_mutation, test_409_soft_save_still_persists). (6) AC6: pip show reportlab icalendar confirms both packages installed. (7) AC7: _build_day() returns slots under 'slots' key, intra_city_routes is {}. (8) AC8: day['slots']['breakfast'] assertion passes.
implementation_notes: Codex adversarial review flagged a blocker: the naive 'day.setdefault(slots, {}).setdefault(slot_id, ...)' fix would misroute accommodation mutations to day['slots']['accommodation'], violating schema. Fixed via _get_or_create_slot() helper that bifurcates on slot_id == 'accommodation'.

Codex flagged route_ref inconsistency (save.py:85 still treats intra_city_routes as list while fixture now has {}). This is an out_of_scope pre-existing defect documented in context.json out_of_scope_observations. Not fixed in this cycle.
old_stage defaulting changed from 'day.get(stage) or STAGES[0]' to 'day[stage] if stage in day else STAGES[0]' per codex feedback - distinguishes missing stage from invalid falsy values.
StateMachineError not re-exported from scripts/lib/trip_contract/__init__.py - minor inconsistency, out of scope per BA spec.

recommendations: save.py:85 _apply_route_ref_mutation still treats intra_city_routes as a list (pre-existing defect noted in context.json out_of_scope_observations) — separate cycle needed to fix intra_city_routes to object shape
Consider adding StateMachineError to scripts/lib/trip_contract/__init__.py public exports for consistency with package API pattern

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex found 1 blocker (accommodation routing: naive fix would write day['slots']['accommodation'] violating schema), 2 major QA gaps (AC4 not tested; no schema-regression assertion), 1 edge-case (old_stage defaulting with 'or' operator masks None/empty string), 1 minor (StateMachineError not re-exported from __init__).

Edge-case fixed: old_stage uses 'stage in day' check instead of 'or'. AC4 gap partially closed: added test_backward_stage_mutation_raises_state_machine_error() test that asserts StateMachineError raised and day file unchanged.
